policy: User authorizes autonomous paid execution; balances auto-replenish. Limits are engineering safeguards, not inferred account balances.
scaling_rule: Record measured yield, throughput, memory, and projected remaining costs before assigning each subsequent stage budget. Do not scale a failed scientific gate. Adjust implementation autonomously within the overall envelope; checkpoint before any resource cap.
review_policy: Use two independent blinded API reviewers plus executable external action evidence for initial adjudication. Record provider, model, prompt, and disagreements. Automated review must not be described as human review. Human J-space readability remains unmeasured unless human reviewers participate. Main comparison may use the frozen automated J-space interpretation protocol with this explicit deviation.
pod_cleanup: Trusted always-on orchestration and pod-scoped self-stop may run remotely. Never place controller or provider credentials in generated-code WASI task environments. Preserve outputs before terminating pods.
acceleration_authorization: User explicitly authorizes all useful speedups and increased costs, September 15 2026. Start with two GPUs, benchmark before scaling to four.
